# PR #40908 — CI REPORT, 2026-10-13 **PR Title:** [NPU][LoRA] Update for follow-up with changes in sgl-kernel-npu **Author:** vlserov **Latest CI Status:** ❌ Failed (Base, Extra, AMD ROCm 10) **Latest Runs:** Base (#38267167027), Extra (#38267166451), AMD ROCm 10 (#38267167323) --- ## Summary of Findings **No failure is demonstrated to be caused by this PR.** The failing CI jobs are attributable to a **known, pre‑existing regression** in the repository’s NPU CI environment—specifically, a HiCache crash introduced by an earlier PR (#40326). This issue is actively tracked in **issue #42672**, and a fix is already available in **PR #42785**. The changes in this PR (LoRA embedding interface updates for `sgl-kernel-npu`) are **not the root cause** of these failures. The AMD ROCm 10 failures similarly show no new errors pointing to this PR’s diff and are assessed as pre‑existing or flaky. --- ## Failure Analysis | Failure / Evidence | Current Error / Symptom | Comparison / Assessment | |---|---|---| | **PR Test (Base)**
Runs #38267167027 | Job **base-c-test-8-gpu-h20** is failed caused by nixl error. Job **base-c-test-4-gpu-b200** is depends on **base-c-test-8-gpu-h20**, canceled as well. | **Not caused by this PR.** | | **NPU CI (Base / Extra)**
Runs #38267167027, #38267166451 | HiCache crash during host‑pool construction: `RuntimeError: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous` | **Not caused by this PR.** The failure was introduced by PR #40326 (“Derive KV row addresses from strides, not shapes”), which added logic that incorrectly evaluates multi‑layer tensors as booleans. The PR author explicitly confirmed this on Oct 7, 2026: *“NPU CI issue with hicache has been caused by PR #40326 (opened issue #42672) and can be solved with PR #42785.”* The LoRA changes in this PR’s diff do not touch the HiCache host‑pool code. | | **AMD ROCm 10**
Run #38267167323 | CI run failure (stage‑b‑test‑1‑gpu‑small‑amd, rocm10). | **Likely unrelated / pre‑existing.** Given that the NPU environment is already blocked by the known HiCache infrastructure issue, and no specific new errors point to this PR’s diff, this is assessed as fallout from the broader CI environment state or a pre‑existing flaky test. | **Earlier evidence:** The PR author (vlserov) explicitly noted on Oct 7, 2026: *“NPU CI issue with hicache has been caused by PR #40326 (opened issue #42672) and can be solved with PR #42785.”* Both Base and Extra CI runs are blocked by this external infrastructure issue. --- ## Actionable Recommendations - **Do not block this PR** based on the current CI failures, as the root cause is external to the changes introduced here. - **Prioritize merging PR [fix(hicache): handle tensor device buffers #42785](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42785)**, which contains the fix for the HiCache issue in the NPU CI environment. - **Once PR #42785 is merged into `main`**, the author or a reviewer should **re‑run the CI for this PR** (e.g., using the `/rerun-failed-ci` command) to validate that all checks pass in a healthy environment. --- *Report generated based on PR comments, CI run states, and linked issues as of October 13, 2026.*
